# Aquent

> Aquent is a global work solutions company connecting creative, marketing, design, and technology talent with enterprise clients through recruiting, staffing, project management, and consulting services.

Aquent operates multiple business units including Aquent Talent (recruiting), Aquent Studios (co-creation agency), RoboHead (project management), Scout (vendor management), and Sustainability consulting. The company serves Fortune 500 brands and is committed to carbon-negative operations and inclusive workplace practices.

- [Aquent Talent: Talent & Recruiting in Marketing, Creative, Design](https://aquent.com/solutions/aquent-talent): Aquent Talent recruiting platform for marketing, creative & design roles
- [Aquent Studios: Global Co/creation Agency](https://aquent.com/solutions/aquent-studios): Aquent Studios co-creation agency with strategy, enablement & activation
- [Aquent RoboHead: Project Management Tool for Marketing & Creative](https://aquent.com/solutions/aquent-robohead): RoboHead project management tool for creative team workflow & capacity
- [Aquent Scout: Smart Vendor Management System](https://aquent.com/solutions/aquent-scout): Aquent Scout VMS streamlines recruiting workflows & vendor management
- [Aquent Employer of Record: Retain Contingent Workers, Great Benefits](https://aquent.com/solutions/aquent-employer-of-record): Aquent EOR service for contingent workforce management & risk mitigation
- [Aquent Sustainability | Consulting & Recruiting | Aquent](https://aquent.com/solutions/aquent-sustainability): Aquent Sustainability recruiting, compliance & ESG consulting services
